value.rationale: The precise number and complete parametrization of mixed subbraces and ideals quantify the naturally motivated Dedekind defect of products of cyclic Dedekind braces. This is an unbounded four-integer-parameter infinite family, not a one-off small table; it provides exact natural counts and a sharp boundary for when factorwise Dedekindness survives product. Historical yes/no classification is credited.
